note: The four accepted Dealer instructions driven by the dedicated checked local-validator campaign. Found, Quote, nonzero Fill and Withdraw are separate transactions with native instruction bytes; infrastructure and participant-funding transactions are deliberately not rebound here.

bindings.label: dealer-found
bindings.note: Accepted Dealer Found. The campaign reads back the Dealer state and its deposited collateral.

bindings.label: dealer-quote
bindings.note: Accepted Dealer Quote against the state created by Dealer Found.

bindings.label: dealer-fill
bindings.note: Accepted nonzero Dealer Fill. The campaign verifies 27 additional Hoard atoms, 9 taker atoms plus 18 Dealer atoms, and the corresponding claim balances.

bindings.label: dealer-withdraw
bindings.note: Accepted nonzero Dealer Withdraw. The campaign verifies the exact three-atom transfer.
